arguments.summary: Credential compromise and lateral movement incident originating from phishing email on WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42). Adversary executed a malicious PowerShell payload from Outlook, leading to Cobalt Strike beacon deployment via an unsigned DLL in the Temp directory. Subsequent actions included host file modification, scheduled task creation for persistence, process injection, and lateral movement via SMB to internal systems. The C2 infrastructure included 198.51.100.23 and domain c2.update-service.xyz. Multiple detection opportunities were present but not escalated promptly.

timeline.description: Legitimate Outlook session initiated by CORP\jsmith on WS-FIN-042.
Malicious encoded PowerShell command executed from within Outlook process (T1566.001).
beacon.dll dropped to %TEMP% (SHA256: a1b2c3d4...).
rundll32.exe loaded beacon.dll from Temp directory (T1218.011).
Hosts file modified to block security update domains (T1565.001).
IDS triggered on Cobalt Strike C2 beacon to 198.51.100.23 (T1071.001).
